Frequently Asked

How do I place an order?

Browse the store, add items to your cart, fill in delivery details, transfer payment to the bank account shown, then tap "Continue Order on WhatsApp" — your full order goes to Joseph instantly.

What areas do you deliver to?

We deliver across Nigeria. Contact us on WhatsApp for same-day delivery availability in your city.

How does eSIM activation work?

After payment, send us a WhatsApp message. We'll send you the eSIM QR code or activation details within minutes. No physical SIM needed.

Can I customize an item?

Yes! Items in the Custom category can be personalised with your name, photo, size, or design. Add your details in the customization field at checkout.

How long does delivery take?

Most orders are dispatched within 24 hours. Delivery typically takes 1–3 business days depending on your location.

What is the bank account for payment?

Moremonee Microfinance Bank — Account: 9064698256 — Name: Joseph Ali. The account details show at checkout and you can copy the number in one tap.

How do I track my order?

Use the Track Order section — enter your order number and a WhatsApp message goes straight to us for a real-time update.

Questions? We're on WhatsApp 24/7

Reach Joseph anytime for custom orders, bulk gifts, eSIM queries or international delivery.
